purpose: Small frozen decision-control evaluation; exploratory usefulness, not artistic superiority or statistical population estimates

runtime.reason: Tokenizer-only sizing found canonical vector comparison prompts above Stage A physical batch2048; context and weights remain unchanged

additional_baseline: All held-out vector cases also run a conventional geometry-aware coverage/length selector using the same visible metrics; straight-only is not the strongest available comparator

probes.states: First model decision of every case, and second vector decision when present, copied exactly from native episode journals
probes.encoding_pair_order: canonical and compact_repeat call order alternates by fixed case/state index; both use the same exact audited state. First-use primary call cost is also retained separately
probes.order_control: Identical observation bytes and candidate objects; only candidate array and named criteria insertion order are reversed
probes.paraphrase_control: Only objective text changes to its precommitted equivalent; observation geometry, budgets, history, candidates and state identity otherwise remain fixed
probes.compaction_control: Canonical and compact encode the identical semantic view, proven by decoder equality. Audit identifiers/program hashes are separated identically in both; original full records are always retained
probes.ablation_control: Direct-only removal of observation.geometry and computed candidate wall clearance, goal distance, offset error, retrace and changed-cell metrics. Raw crop, coordinates, target, history and task constraints remain

scoring.direct: Frozen case clearance/retrace/arrival requirements AND explicit policy STOP; native confirmed movement/material path; geometric local-search baseline receives the same observation
scoring.fuzzy: Actual native required-cell coverage, allowed spill, four-neighbor connectivity and support predicates; graph termination alone never success
scoring.vector: Correct target endpoint intent AND exact chosen-vector preservation, contiguous path, <=3x travel, frozen coverage/length preference and native material equality; planning transition has no native mutation
scoring.random: Uniform seeded selection among sorted legal IDs including STOP (and fuzzy SKIP), reported as non-model baseline; three held-out seeds
scoring.all: No repair or retry of poor legal choices. Invalid decisions, STOP, budget exhaustion, refusals and model failures are retained

stage_c_gate.prerequisites: All native custody, safety, replay and process-cleanup gates pass; no unintended material writes
stage_c_gate.above_random: At least one family meets its success threshold and its model success fraction strictly exceeds pooled three-seed random success fraction
stage_c_gate.robustness: For that family, >=75% of paired reverse-order and >=75% of paired paraphrase probes retain the primary selected ID; at least one pair of each kind must exist
stage_c_gate.incremental_value: Report separately whether direct exceeds or merely matches geometric baseline, and whether fuzzy/vector surpass fixed/straight policies. Matching ordinary code at higher cost is not evidence of direct incremental value
stage_c_gate.authorized_expansion: If the exploratory useful-behavior gate passes, at most two new fixtures each for Pipework, Architecture and Greebles, at most three model actions per fixture, actual native receipts/replay and graphical Workbench inspection. No training or broad search

freeze_policy: Catalogs, primary policy, seeds, scores and thresholds are committed before any held-out model inference. Development may reveal implementation defects; any repair must preserve held-out outcomes, declare affected runs and use a new exact source qualification
claims: One resident model for primary episodes and paired probes
Native material PNGs are not framebuffer captures
Small exploratory cohort; no generalization or statistical significance claim
No scheduled workers, training, merge or production-default changes
